description: This file defines two exported asynchronous functions, 'getOAuthApiKey' and 'refreshOpenAICodexToken', which serve as wrappers around external functions imported from the '@mariozechner/pi-ai/oauth' module. It also ensures the environment is properly configured by calling 'ensureGlobalUndiciEnvProxyDispatcher' from 'openclaw/plugin-sdk/runtime-env' before invoking the external functions.

methods.name: export async function getOAuthApiKey( getOAuthApiKey
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves an OAuth API key by calling the external 'getOAuthApiKey' function after ensuring the global environment is correctly set up.

methods.name: export async function refreshOpenAICodexToken( refreshOpenAICodexToken
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes the OpenAI Codex token by invoking the external 'refreshOpenAICodexToken' function after environment setup.
